description: Parcel polygons for Utah County joined to assessor/tax-roll attributes (owner-address, serial, acreage, market value, land value, year built, building sqft, floors, primary-residence flag, property class, subdivision name) via the statewide Land Information Records (LIR) schema.
publisher: UGRC / Utah SGID (in coordination with Utah County Assessor)
notes: 327,655 parcel records, all COUNTY_NAME='Utah County'. The authoritative growth/housing base layer: land value, built year, unit/floor counts, property class per parcel. Do NOT bulk-download; query by bbox/where. Fields incl. TOTAL_MKT_VALUE, BUILT_YR, HOUSE_CNT, BLDG_SQFT, SUBDIV_NAME, PROP_CLASS.

description: Parcel boundary polygons for Utah County (same LIR fabric; use the LIR variant for attributes).
notes: 284,092 polygons. Geometry-focused cut; use Parcels_Utah_LIR instead unless you only need boundaries.

description: Point locations for every USPS-assigned address in Utah; the state's authoritative geocoding base.
notes: 246,902 points in Utah County (filter CountyID='49049'). Backs address->rep lookups. Statewide layer; also queryable by City / bbox.

description: Incorporated municipal (city/town) boundaries statewide, COGO-derived, maintained with annexation updates; carries census/estimate population per municipality.
notes: 27 municipalities in Utah County (filter COUNTYNBR='25'). Which land is in which city vs unincorporated -- the frame for every jurisdictional growth question. Carries POPLASTCENSUS/POPLASTESTIMATE.

description: County boundary polygons statewide (includes Utah County / FIPS 49049).
notes: County extent for clipping/joins; filter NAME='UTAH'.

description: Best-effort inventory of housing units per development/parcel (single-family, ADU/OUG, townhome, condo, duplex, apartment, mobile-home park, PUD) with unit count, density (DUA), value, and approximate build year, built from parcel/LIR/assessor data.
notes: 195,204 records for Utah County (filter COUNTY='UTAH') ~= 231,597 housing units. Directly answers housing supply/type/density. See derived/ for the type breakdown.

description: Building footprint polygons statewide with type/address/parcel-id and source year.
notes: 191,853 footprints in Utah County (filter COUNTY='UTAH'). Built-form / density analysis; joins to parcels via PARCEL_ID. Utah County's own org publishes NO footprints layer -- use this.

description: 2020 Census tract polygons (P.L. 94-171 redistricting geography) with POP100/HU100.
notes: 156 tracts in Utah County (filter GEOID20 LIKE '49049%'). Standard demographic/housing join geography.

description: 2020 Census block-group polygons.
notes: 434 block groups in Utah County (GEOID20 LIKE '49049%'). Finer demographic geography for density analysis.

description: 2020 Census block polygons (finest census geography).
notes: Large statewide layer; query by bbox or GEOID20 prefix '49049'.

description: Census tracts eligible/designated for the federal Opportunity Zone development-incentive program.
notes: 156 eligible tracts in Utah County (filter COUNTYF='049'); 716 statewide. Development-incentive overlay (eligible/candidate tracts, not all federally designated).

description: Utah Enterprise Zone boundaries (state tax-credit economic-development areas).
notes: 109 polygons statewide (rural + targeted areas); economic-development overlay.

description: Agricultural/water-related land-use and crop-type polygons in and around Utah (has a County field).
notes: Agricultural land use only (NOT urban zoning); filter County='UTAH'. Useful for ag-to-urban conversion questions along the Utah County urban fringe.

description: County-maintained municipal (city/town) boundary polygons with NAME, TYPE, local FIPS, acreage, and per-feature data source.
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data (no explicit license; attribute source)
notes: 26 municipal polygons, county-maintained. County twin of the SGID UtahMunicipalBoundaries; use whichever schema fits (SGID carries population).

description: City label points (name only) for Utah County municipalities.
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 28 city points; cartographic label layer only (Name field). Use City_Boundaries for polygons.

description: Statewide county boundary polygons as maintained/hosted by Utah County GIS.
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 29 county polygons (statewide copy); prefer SGID UtahCountyBoundaries. County extent for clipping.

description: Recorded subdivision/plat BLOCK polygons countywide (survey, plat, block, book/page references).
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 1,240 plat-block polygons (CITY_NAME, SURVEY_NAM, PLAT, BLOCK, BOOK/PAGE). Recorded-plat fabric -- a proxy for platted/subdivided land; NOT a live subdivision-application layer.

description: Recorded subdivision/plat LOT polygons countywide.
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 7,852 plat-lot polygons (CITY_NAME, PLAT, BLOCK, LOT, BOOK/PAGE). Closest county-hosted proxy for subdivision/lot activity; the county publishes NO harmonized subdivision-boundary layer.

description: Redevelopment Agency, Community Development, and tax-increment project-area boundaries countywide, with project name, town, tax district, inception and end year.
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 41 project areas (REDEV name, TOWN, YEAR_/LAST_YEAR tax-increment window). Development-incentive/tax-increment overlay -- a direct signal of subsidized growth by municipality.

description: County road network polylines.
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 923 road polylines; transportation frame (county-maintained roads, not a full address-range centerline).

description: Public Land Survey System township polygons for Utah County (township/range/base-meridian).
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 100 PLSS townships (TOWNSHIP/RANGE/BASEMERIDIAN). Cadastral survey reference, not unincorporated municipal 'townships'.

description: Public Land Survey System section polygons countywide.
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 2,297 PLSS sections; cadastral survey reference grid.

description: Modeled roadway-segment results with lanes, volume, capacity, volume/capacity ratio and level-of-service for build and no-build 2050 scenarios (Transportation Master Plan travel-demand model).
license: Public -- Utah County GIS open data
notes: 28,010 roadway segments (vol_b50/cap_b50/los_b50 build vs vol_nb50 no-build). Future roadway loading tied to growth -- the closest county-published growth-projection GIS layer.
